title: When Record-Keeping Becomes a Second Job
description: Lost receipts, scattered notes, and audit preparation take hours away from your farm. Explore the everyday gaps SPIDER Ag helps close.

cards.title: The Cost of Chasing Paperwork
cards.description: Hunting for receipts, retyping field notes, and piecing together an audit trail costs hours. Capture records as work happens and get that time back.

cards.title: Records Scattered Across Systems
cards.description: Keep paper logs, photos, and field notes together by farm, field, plot, and subplot, using the names and boundaries you already know.

cards.title: Field Notes Left Behind
cards.description: Say why a job changed or an application was delayed. Turn that field note into a dated task, then review and confirm the details.

cards.title: When Cell Service Drops
cards.description: Record voice notes and take photos without cell service. The mobile app saves them offline and syncs when you reconnect.
